name: Backfill Drive Metadata to cv_queue
description: One-time/manual backfill: lists all files in Google Drive and inserts fileId, fileName, mimeType, status='pending' into cv_queue, skipping duplicates.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO cv_queue ("fileId", "fileName", "mimeType", "status", "webViewLink")
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
ON CONFLICT ("fileId") DO NOTHING
